claim: For every absolutely positive-partial-transpose state \(\rho\) on \(\mathbb C^3\otimes\mathbb C^3\), \(\operatorname{Tr}(\rho^2)\leq \frac{312737}{2120625}\). This gives an explicit rational gap of \(\frac{12544}{27568125}\) below the outer-polytope maximum \(\frac{25}{169}\); it is not the exact APPT maximum.
scientific_integrity: The bound is proved from exact rational vertex calculations for the nine-dimensional outer spectral polytope and a necessary two-qutrit Hildebrand matrix inequality. No exact APPT maximizer, global novelty certification, or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The rational upper bound is non-sharp and specific to \(3\otimes3\) APPT spectra. The exact maximum APPT purity remains open.
title: An explicit purity gap for absolutely PPT two-qutrit spectra
